summary: Iteration 3 — full test of GYMBOSS_VVO Milestones 2-5 (new modules) plus M1 regression. drawer summary + due; action sheet Freeze->Frozen + expiry +5d, Unfreeze, Record Payment 500 -> due 2,000->1,500 with receipt modal + print button, Transaction/Attendance/More-Info views with back nav, Payment Reminder WhatsApp modal with filled template, Renew -> expiry extended, Edit batch, Delete with confirm dialog -> row removed), Plans (create 3-mo Rs.4500 -> edit to 5200 -> delete with confirm; PT/Service/Product tabs expose sessions/category/inventory fields), Attendance (check-in Shreya 12->13 and appears in today list, duplicate blocked with friendly toast 'Shreya Saxena is already checked in', Check Out writes check-out time, History tab daily counts), Payments (method filter UPI 20->15 rows, Record Payment via member picker showing outstanding due, receipt modal from list row renders full receipt), Enquiries (create, follow-up toast, Convert -> /app/members with prefilled Add Member form -> submit -> enquiry becomes Converted), Expenses (total Rs.8,500, create, delete with confirm), Outlets (primary outlet disable correctly refused with honest toast), Staff (create with email+password -> staff can log in to /app/dashboard -> disable -> login blocked, stays on /login), Announcements (preview recipient count 23, Send Now -> HONEST toast 'WhatsApp integration is required...', history row status 'Integration Required', detail drawer with 23 wa.me recipient links, Cancel works), Finance (KPIs Rs. formatted, range Today recomputes), Reports (revenue + growth charts render SVG, dues total Rs.16,200/7 members, conversion cards 7/1/14.3%/6), Export Center (7 cards, members CSV actually downloads gymboss_members_2026-09-03.csv), Settings (gym profile save, dark/light theme switch sets html.dark, integrations show Not Connected honestly), Subscription (trial 9 days left, razorpay-not-configured note, Subscribe -> honest 503 toast), Support (request submitted + wa.me link uses saved platform number 919876543210), Profile save, Super Admin console (8 overview KPIs, 3 gyms, gym detail drawer, platform settings save, 100 audit rows).

critical.issue: BLOCKER FOUND AND ROOT-CAUSED: the demo gym's plan documents in the preview DB had NO 'type' field (they were written by the Milestone-1 seed as {category:'membership'}). seed_demo() early-returns when the demo user already exists (server.py:460), so the new 7-plan seed with 'type' never migrated the existing 4 docs. Result: GET /api/plans?type=membership returned [] for the demo gym, so the Add Member plan dropdown, Members plan filter, Plans page Membership tab, Renew plan select and announcement plan-audience were ALL EMPTY -- the entire member-creation flow was unusable for the demo account. I patched the 4 demo plan docs in MongoDB (set type='membership') to unblock testing; the code path is still unfixed. Make seed_demo migration-aware (e.g. $set type on plans missing it / version the seed) or the same breakage returns on any environment seeded before Milestone 2.

minor.issue: role is stored title-cased (role.capitalize() -> 'Trainer') while the users collection stores the lowercase role. Round-tripping StaffBody (send 'trainer', read back 'Trainer') breaks strict client-side comparisons; keep one canonical casing and format for display only.
Refusing to disable the primary outlet returns 422 (validation semantics) for what is a business-rule conflict; 400/409 would be more accurate. Message is honest and surfaced correctly in the UI.
Duplicate same-day check-in returns 409 (correct and friendly), but note the review brief said 400 — no change needed, flagged only so future tests assert 409.
all_active audience returned 23 for the demo gym, while the brief expected 22. Count is derived correctly (active + expiring_soon) — the brief's number is stale; verify which definition is intended.

Several endpoints still load full collections with .to_list(10000/20000) and aggregate in Python (also flagged in iteration_2 for /dashboard/summary). Fine at demo scale; move to aggregation pipelines before multi-thousand-member tenants.

ui_bugs.component: Attendance History tab / Reports dues tab
ui_bugs.issue: React console error: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' when rendering the attendance-history daily list and the reports dues table. No functional break but it indicates missing/duplicate keys.

Repeated console error: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users.' Triggered by the member detail drawer / at least one dialog that has no DialogTitle. Accessibility defect.

Recording a payment from /app/payments only shows a 'Payment recorded' toast and does NOT open the receipt modal, while the same action from the member drawer does open it. Inconsistent; the per-row Receipt button does work.

Logging in with a disabled staff account correctly stays on /login, but no persistent error message was visible in the DOM 4s later (no .error element, toast already gone). Consider an inline, non-transient 'This account has been disabled' message.

integration_issues.issue: Before the DB patch, the plan Select opened as an empty popover with no options and no empty-state text, so the user cannot tell why they cannot proceed (root cause = the seed_demo type bug above). Add an explicit 'No plans yet — create one in Plans & Catalogue' empty item to the plan Select so this class of failure is self-explanatory.

design_issues.screen: Add Member / Add Expense / Freeze / Follow-up modals
issues: Date fields use the raw browser date input (renders as mm/dd/yyyy with the native picker) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover component — inconsistent with the rest of the design system and shows US date order in an India-only product.

design_issues.screen: Members list (and other list pages) — filtered empty result
issues: When a search or filter returns nothing, the table shows the first-run empty state 'No members yet / Add your first member to begin managing memberships' with an Add Member CTA. Misleading for a 26-member gym; show a 'No members match your filters / Clear filters' state instead.

Violet theme verified premium in both light and dark (html.dark) mode; no orange brand colours remain. Only amber/#F59E0B usages left are semantic (expiring-soon badge, Expenses bar in the revenue chart) which is correct.

action_items: CRITICAL: make seed_demo() (and any org seeding) migration-aware so existing plan documents get the 'type' field; the demo gym was completely unable to add/renew members because GET /api/plans?type=membership returned []. I patched the 4 demo plan docs in Mongo as a stop-gap only.
Add a visible empty-state option inside the plan Select (member form, renew, filters) so an empty catalogue is self-explanatory instead of an empty popover.
Fix the missing React 'key' props in the attendance-history list and reports dues table.
Add a DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden title) to the member detail drawer / offending DialogContent for screen-reader accessibility.
Replace the native date inputs in the member/expense/freeze/follow-up forms with the shadcn Calendar component (and dd/mm/yyyy display for India).
Show a 'No results match your filters' empty state instead of the first-run 'No members yet' state when a search/filter returns 0 rows.
Optionally open the receipt modal after Record Payment on /app/payments for parity with the member drawer flow.
Normalise staff role casing between db.staff.role ('Trainer') and db.users.role ('trainer').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:458-461 seed_demo(): the `if await db.users.find_one({'email': email}): return` guard makes the seed non-upgradable. Milestone 2 added plan.type but existing demo data was never migrated — this produced the CRITICAL empty-plan-dropdown blocker. Any future seed field addition will silently break preview environments the same way.

members.py list_plans(): filtering strictly on `type` with no fallback to the legacy `category` field means one missing field silently empties every plan-driven UI. Consider `{'$or': [{'type': t}, {'type': {'$exists': False}, 'category': t}]}` for resilience, or a startup migration.

finance.py / server.py: repeated `.to_list(10000)`+Python aggregation across finance/reports/dashboard. Extract a shared aggregation helper — it is now duplicated in 4+ handlers (DRY) and will not scale.
Tenant isolation is implemented consistently: every handler I exercised scopes by organisation_id and returns 404 (not 403) for cross-tenant ids; export also scopes correctly. No leaks found.

Billing honesty verified end-to-end: create-order 503 with a clear message, verify() rejects forged signatures, announcements set status='integration_required' and the UI toast tells the truth instead of faking success.

rca_of_the_issue: CRITICAL blocker RCA: GET /api/plans?type=membership returned [] for the demo gym. Reproduction: login demo@gymbossvvo.in -> /app/members -> Add Member -> click the Membership Plan select -> popover opens with zero options -> submit shows 'Select a membership plan' forever. Cause: members.py list_plans() filters on the `type` field, but the demo org's plan documents were inserted by the Milestone-1 seeder as {name:'Monthly', category:'membership'} with no `type` key, and server.py seed_demo() returns early when the demo user already exists (line 460), so the Milestone-2 seed data (which does set type) never replaced or migrated them. Mitigation applied for testing: db.plans.update_many({'type':{'$exists':False}},{'$set':{'type':'membership'}}) (4 docs). Permanent fix required in seed_demo()/a startup migration so already-seeded environments are upgraded, plus a defensive fallback in list_plans().
